title: Rank Salaries
learning_objective: Learn how ranking functions assign positions to ordered rows.

tutorial.explanation: Ranking functions compare rows based on an ORDER BY inside OVER. For salary problems, high salaries usually rank first.
tutorial.syntax: SELECT employee_name, salary, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_rank FROM employees;
tutorial.mental_model: The window ORDER BY defines the competition. Ranking functions number each row after sorting.

guided_example.prompt: Rank all employees by salary descending.
guided_example.solution_query: SELECT employee_name, salary, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_rank FROM employees;
guided_example.explanation: RANK assigns the same rank to ties, then leaves a gap after the tie.

practice.prompt: Return employee_name, salary, and row_number ordered by salary descending.
practice.expected_query: SELECT employee_name, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS row_number FROM employees;
